note: Forested hills on the Nagaland border. 3-4 isolated huts in clearings with dirt tracks to them. No OSM road at all within the zoom-14 view (~3 km); only the state boundary is drawn.
Tea garden. A grid labour-line settlement (~40 houses) at the centre with estate roads on all sides. OSM has only Dhodar Ali at the NW corner; nothing inside the garden is mapped.

Tea garden. Village row along the north edge of the circle (~350 m N of point) and a factory/labour line to the SE. Estate tracks everywhere. OSM shows no road here; the grey line across the top of the OSM view is a power line, not a road. Nearest mapped road is at the SW corner.
Tea garden only, no houses seen anywhere in the circle. Estate tracks visible but nothing to connect. One OSM track at the east edge, ~800 m from the point.

Inside a Dikhow river meander. Main village road to the W is mapped with buildings; the compound with a large blue roof near the centre and the houses on the E bank have visible lanes but no OSM road. E-bank houses have no mapped road at all.
Dense unbroken forest (reserve forest south of Sivasagar). No houses, no tracks. Nearest OSM road ~3 km to the SW.

Tea garden west of the Dikhow / Naginimora. A full estate road grid is visible; a few staff houses at the NE (by the river) and SW. OSM has nothing but the river and a few buildings; nearest road ~2.5 km, across the river in Nagaland.

Populated farming village with a dense lane network and a tight house cluster SE of the point. OSM has only one road along the north edge (~1.1 km from the main cluster); grey lines on OSM are power lines.
Hill hamlet (~10 houses) beside the Bhogdoi stream; the wide pale band is the stream bed, not a road. Only footpaths/narrow tracks between houses. No OSM road within ~2 km (same view as point 1).
Roadside village on the national highway (Jorhat East). Highway and two side roads to the N are mapped; the lanes S of the highway where the point sits are not.
Garhgaon (Gargaon Kareng Ghar area). Village roads and buildings are mapped in detail; the point itself is in fields between mapped roads.
Jorhat town, Bhogdoi riverside next to NH702D. Dense OSM road network. The point sits on the low pond/floodplain strip between the river and the eastern neighbourhood.
